To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ifosfamide may be useful as a component of salvage regimens for patients with germ cell cancer, but its role as a component of first-line treatment is unclear.
ifosfamide may be useful in the treatment of germ cell tumors and may be useful in small cell lung cancer.
the substitution of iffosfamide for bleomyocin in the standard combination of bleomycin/episide/cisplatinum did not improve efficacy in germ cell tumors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of ifosfamides in germ cell tumors, small cell lung cancer and other solid tumors.
the development of new therapeutic approaches for patients with germ cell and small cell lung tumors.
the role of ifofamide in the treatment of patients with germ cell and small cell lung cancers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ifosfamide, as a single agent or in combination, has a role in the treatment of patients with germ cell and small cell lung cancers.
ifosfamide should be used only in clinical trials.
the role of iffosamide in solid tumors is evolving.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ifosfamide may be useful in the treatment of patients with germ cell cancer who do not respond to standard therapy or who have relapsed after first-line treatment with BEP.
ifosfamide may have a role in the treatment of germ cell tumors and in small cell lung cancer.

ifosfamide may have a role in the salvage treatment of patients with germ cell cancer who are resistant to cisplatin-containing chemotherapy regimens, but its value in the initial management of these patients remains to be determined.
The main takeaway from our work is that

ifosfamide should be used in combination chemotherapy regimens in patients with small cell lung cancer who have not received prior chemotherapy, and that ifosfamides should be avoided in patients who have received prior chemotherapy.
we need to be more careful in our interpretation of the data from the studies of the role of ifofamide in small cell lung cancer and germ cell tumors.
we need to continue to develop new drugs and new combinations of existing drugs.
